text: Yes?
zh: 啥事？

text: Have you found out anything about the stone door yet?
zh: 关于那扇石门，你查到什么了吗？

text: I opened the stone door.
zh: 我把石门打开了。

text: Did you find what you were looking for in the ruins?
zh: 你在遗迹里找到你要找的东西了吗？

text: Have you ever seen a key like this? (Bellkeeper Key)
zh: 你见过这样的钥匙吗？（守钟人钥匙）

text: Regarding the key of a bellkeeper...
zh: 关于守钟人的钥匙……

text: Do you sell the fake key of the bellkeeper?
zh: 那把守钟人的假钥匙你卖吗？

text: I'm on my way.
zh: 我先走了。

text: Catch you later!
zh: 回见！

text: I am working on it.
zh: 我还在想办法。

text: Though...
zh: 不过……

text: I overheard someone talkin' 'bout the library in the capital. The king's library to be specific.
zh: 我偶然听人聊起王都的图书馆。确切地说，是国王的图书馆。

text: However, only the king, his mages or someone with the advisor's permission may access the library.
zh: 不过，只有国王、他的法师，或是拿到顾问许可的人才能进图书馆。

text: Unless you get a permission, we may have to find something else.
zh: 除非你能弄到许可，不然咱们就得另想办法了。

text:
You did it?
How?
zh:
你办到了？
怎么做到的？

text: By using one of Lyrak's scrolls.
zh: 用了莱拉克的一张卷轴。

text:
Awesome!
I owe you one.
zh:
太棒了！
我欠你个人情。

text: But first, I need to check out what's inside these ruins.
zh: 不过首先，我得去看看遗迹里头有什么。

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text: More or less.
zh: 算是吧。

text:
But I'm still waiting for my client.
After all, he was the one who wanted to know what was in the ruins.
zh:
但我还在等我的雇主。
毕竟，是他想知道遗迹里有什么。

text:
You helped me a lot with my mission.
Without you, I would still be searching for a way to open the stone door.
zh:
这趟差事你帮了我大忙。
没有你，我现在还在琢磨怎么打开那扇石门呢。

text:
Take this as your reward.
You deserve it.
zh:
这是给你的报酬。
你应得的。

text:
However, on the lowest level, behind the undead knight, there was another door.
Did you see that?
zh:
不过，在最底层，那个不死骑士身后还有一扇门。
你看到了吗？

text: It looked like you need four keys to make the thing move.
zh: 看样子得用四把钥匙才能让那玩意儿动起来。

text:
But that would be too much for me right now.
I'm glad I made it out of the ruins alive.
zh:
但眼下那对我来说太勉强了。
能活着从遗迹里出来我就谢天谢地了。

text: Let me see!
zh: 让我瞧瞧！

text:
That's an interestingly shaped key.
Also, what's that material? It looks like gold. Is it?
zh:
这钥匙的造型真有意思。
还有，这是什么材质？看着像金子。是吗？

text: Where did you find that key?
zh: 你在哪儿找到这把钥匙的？

text: In one of the ruins with the stone doors.
zh: 在一处有石门的遗迹里。

text: In one of these ruins, you say?
zh: 你是说，就在那些遗迹里？

text: Huh, I was sure I grabbed everything worth takin'.
zh: 嗯？我明明确信值钱的东西都被我搜刮干净了。

text: Also, Could this be the thing my client is looking for?
zh: 还有，这该不会就是我雇主要找的东西吧？

text: Listen, I might have a plan!
zh: 听着，我可能有个计划！

text:
There's a guy I trust in the capital who can forge anything.
Give me the key, and I'll have a duplicate made.
zh:
王都里有个我信得过的家伙，什么都能仿造。
把钥匙给我，我去弄个复制品。

text: The fake goes to my client, I get the gold and you can have the real one.
zh: 假的给我雇主，金币归我，真钥匙归你。

text: Yeah?
zh: 怎么样？

text: Why should I give you the key?
zh: 我凭什么把钥匙给你？

text: Take the key.
zh: 钥匙拿去吧。

text: I need to think about it.
zh: 我得考虑考虑。

text:
Hehe, I knew it!
How about you get some gold as soon as I have the duplicate?
zh:
嘿嘿，我就知道！
等我拿到复制品，就分你一些金币，怎么样？

text: If not, I'm sure we'll find something to make it worth your time.
zh: 就算不行，咱们也肯定能找到别的好处，不会让你白忙活。

text: Alright! I'll head off to the capital now.
zh: 好嘞！我这就动身去王都。

text: You know where to find me!
zh: 你知道上哪儿找我！

text: Best if we meet up there.
zh: 咱们最好在那儿碰头。

text: You'll likely find me near the fountain, just beside the market square.
zh: 你多半能在喷泉附近找到我，就在市集广场旁边。

text: Man, I can't do that!
zh: 老兄，这可不行！

text:
While I am not sure, I think my client is interested in the key.
And I am interested in my client's money, you know?
zh:
虽说我也不确定，但我觉得我雇主感兴趣的就是这把钥匙。
而我感兴趣的是雇主的钱，你懂吧？

text: How much does your client pay?
zh: 你的雇主出多少钱？

text: I want to buy the key.
zh: 我想买下这把钥匙。

text: I'll be back later.
zh: 我稍后再来。

text: Haha! So, if you're trying to make a counteroffer, I'm afraid I'll have to disappoint you.
zh: 哈哈！所以，要是你想跟我抬价竞买，恐怕得让你失望了。

text: I was actually planning to keep this to myself. My client is paying me a handsome sum of 5000 gold coins.
zh: 这事我本来打算烂在肚子里的。我雇主可是要付我一大笔钱——足足5000金币。

text: Also, I've spent at least half the amount on the forgery already.
zh: 而且，光是仿造那把钥匙，我就至少花掉了一半的钱。

text:
You're kidding, right?
I already told you, that my client will most likely pay 5000 gold for the key.
zh:
你在开玩笑吧？
我都说了，我雇主多半会为这把钥匙付5000金币。

text: I can give you 5000 gold coins right now.
zh: 我现在就能给你5000金币。

text: Take these 7000 gold coins.
zh: 收下这7000金币吧。

text: I'll think about it.
zh: 我再考虑考虑。

text: Forget it. This key is reseved for my client.
zh: 想都别想。这把钥匙是留给我雇主的。

text:
Nope!
I don't need the money that badly to break my deal with my client.
zh:
不行！
我还没缺钱缺到要毁掉和雇主交易的地步。

text: You sure your client is even after the key?
zh: 你确定你的雇主要的真是这把钥匙？

text: Pretty sure, yeah. Why do you ask?
zh: 相当确定。怎么这么问？

text: What if they're after something completely different?
zh: 万一他们要找的完全是别的东西呢？

text: All I'd end up with in my pocket is a golden key that doesn't even come close to covering the expenses. That's what you're trying to say, right?
zh: 那我兜里最后就只剩一把连成本都远远抵不上的金钥匙。你想说的是这个，对吧？

text:
Fine. I'll consider a deal.
But only if it seriously benefits me.
zh:
行吧。我可以考虑做笔交易。
但前提是我得有实实在在的好处。

text: How much gold are we talking?
zh: 你要多少金币？

text: Let me think. That forgery cost me a fortune. Plus, I'm risking my client's wrath.
zh: 让我想想。那件仿品花了我一大笔钱。再说，我还得冒着惹恼雇主的风险。

text: All things considered… #:7000 gold:#.
zh: 全都算上的话……#:7000金币:#。

text:
He! He he!
That's... a lot of money.
zh:
嘿！嘿嘿！
这……可真是一大笔钱。

text: Thanks, buddy! Here's the duplicate.
zh: 谢了，伙计！这是那件复制品。
